create_QTranBase: create a QTranBase mixer network instance with coma_critic or qtran_paper architecture and small or big network size
run_QTranBase_forward: run the QTranBase forward pass with a batch, hidden states, and optional actions to get Q and V outputs
build_Q_network: build the Q network for joint action-value estimation using state and action inputs through a multi-layer MLP
build_V_network: build the V network for state-value estimation using state inputs through a multi-layer MLP
review_action_encoding: review the action_encoding network that encodes agent hidden states and actions for the qtran_paper architecture
